About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. The project brings together apartments and ground-level retail within a building organised across two basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels and 15 residential floors. The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The range is relatively focused, moving from more compact one-bedroom homes to larger four-bedroom residences. The design includes private balconies and terraces, with built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, and contemporary kitchen cabinetry and countertops. Large windows, double-glazed glazing and fibre-optic connectivity are among the documented features of the residences. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. description: Reference: YHKN-T13222. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top.
